svg.title: Trace delivery separately for each recipient
svg.desc: Two people can receive different results for the same message. Use the message ID and the recipient together. Identify. Match the message ID in each delivery record. Compare. Read the final status for each recipient. Investigate. For a failed delivery, find the matching bounce notice before proposing a cause.
